Loupe's icon. A size scale for the icon tag: xs is 3, sm is 3.5, md is 4, lg is 5, xl is 8 and 2xl is 12. xl and 2xl are for an empty-state icon. No component wraps it.

```jsx
<Icon variant="xs" />
<Icon variant="sm" />
<Icon variant="md" />
<Icon variant="lg" />
<Icon variant="xl" />
<Icon variant="2xl" />
```

Variants: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `2xl`.

Pass the shapes of a Lucide icon as children. The component emits the real `lp-icon` classes of the app.
